links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting and static prompting with random exemplars (SPR)
links.outcome: False-positive rate, recall in error sentence detection, and error correction quality on MEDEC across nine LLMs
links.effect: RDP reduced FPR by about 15 percent, improved recall by 5 to 10 percent in error sentence detection, and generated more contextually accurate corrections
links.quote: Across all nine LLMs, RDP reduced FPR by about 15 percent, improved recall by 5 to 10 percent in error sentence detection, and generated more contextually accurate corrections.

links.effect: SPR improved recall over zero-shot, which had low recall in both detection tasks, but increased FPR; no numbers reported for this comparison
